VCE_Grass.source: CCTO generic Grass 0°C cold dormancy, analogous grazing perennial; species unspecified.

VCE_TallGrass.source: CCTO Tall grass 0°C cold dormancy; leaves disappear over winter as VPE has leafless graphic.

VCE_Agave.source: CCTO Vanilla Agave exact 5/-7 balance; genus and cultivars vary in natural hardiness.

VCE_Onion.source: CCTO Medieval Overhaul Onion exact 5/-3 balance; avoids two conflicting Onion profiles.

VCE_Pumpkin.source: CCTO Medieval Overhaul Pumpkin exact 10/-1 and PSU warm-season germination.

VCE_Pepper.source: PSU pepper minimum seed germination 60°F (15.6°C), warmer than tomato 50°F; 12°C gameplay growth cutoff; -1°C frost damage approximation.

VCE_Tomato.source: CCTO Medieval Overhaul Tomato exact 10/-1; PSU seeds more warm-sensitive than onions.

VCE_AppleTree.source: CCTO Medieval Overhaul Apple exact 5°C cold dormancy; apple/pear dormancy response research.

VCE_PeachTree.source: UGA extension: peaches overwinter dormant; frost bud damage is not whole-tree death.

VCE_PlumTree.source: UGA extension: plums behave similarly to peaches in dormancy/bloom damage.

VCE_PearTree.source: Apple/pear temperature-driven dormancy research; VPE describes cool-climate pear.

VCE_Opuntia.source: VPE generic desert prickly pear, species unspecified; -8°C is moderate gameplay approximation, NOT an observed Opuntia lethal temperature.

VCE_BearBerryBush.source: UMN identifies northern bearberry Arctostaphylos uva-ursi as hardy broadleaf evergreen; keep leaves, use very low fallback cold death for game balance (not experimentally measured).

VCE_BananaTree.source: UF/IFAS: growth slows <16°C and freezes at <=0°C, <-2°C kills aboveground; game loses rhizome regrowth, so fixed death approximates plant loss.
